stated_text: U izvještajnom periodu nastavljena je implementacija Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o strancima („Sl. list CG“, broj 3/26)
translation_en: In the reporting period, implementation of the Law on amendments to the Law on Foreigners (Official Gazette of Montenegro, No. 3/26) continued
summary: Government: implementation of the amending law continued in the reporting period.
note: Section Zakonite i nezakonite migracije. Government self-report with no independent check. Quote is the first clause of the sentence.

stated_text: Primjenom novih zakonskih rješenja dodatno su unaprijeđene procedure u oblasti boravka stranaca, uključujući postupke odobravanja privremenog boravka, privremenog boravka i rada, kao i ostvarivanje prava državljana Evropske unije i članova njihovih porodica u skladu sa standardima Evropske unije.
translation_en: By applying the new legal solutions, procedures in the field of residence of foreigners were further improved, including the procedures for granting temporary residence and temporary residence and work, as well as the exercise of the rights of European Union nationals and their family members in line with European Union standards.
summary: Government: applying the new law further improved procedures, including EU nationals' rights.
note: Section Zakonite i nezakonite migracije. Government self-report, no measure given; the law is named in the preceding sentence (NEW-FMW-1).

translation_en: Law on Foreigners (Official Gazette of Montenegro, Nos. 12/2018, 3/2019, 86/2022, 77/2024, 3/2026 and 33/2026)
summary: Government annex cites the Law on Foreigners with a further 2026 amendment, SL 33/2026.
note: Section Izbjeglice i interno raseljena lica; the citation appears in a passage on statelessness. Used only to disclose that SL 33/2026 was not read. No intervention record exists for it.

stated_text: Laws on foreigners have recently been revised in all four countries to include, among other amendments, the posting of EU workers to these countries.
summary: Secondary study: foreigners laws in the four countries covered, which it treats as including Serbia, were revised to cover posting of EU workers.
note: Section 4. Used only to qualify the absence claim in CMP-0003. Regional wording: the next sentences name North Macedonia, Montenegro, Albania and Serbia. Posting may belong to another issue; for the analyst.

stated_text: Stupanjem na snagu ovoga Zakona prestaje važiti Zakon o strancima (»Narodne novine«, br. 79/07. i 36/09.).
translation_en: On the entry into force of this Act, the Aliens Act (Official Gazette Nos. 79/07 and 36/09) ceases to apply.
summary: NN 130/2011 repeals the earlier Aliens Act, NN 79/07 and 36/09.
